_comment: Copy this file to config.json (same folder as run_qdm_daily.ps1) and edit. Symbols are grouped by data source; each source can have its own export timezone.
_Mt5CommonOverride_comment: Leave empty to auto-use %APPDATA%\MetaQuotes\Terminal\Common\Files\QDM. Set only for portable/non-standard MT5 installs.
_FullFromDate_comment: History depth for -Full runs, format yyyy.MM.dd. Empty string = everything QDM has.
_TickBatchSize_comment: Tick exports run in sequential batches of this many symbols. Bounds disk usage and avoids QDM's silent same-symbol job drops.
_MinFreeSpaceGB_comment: -Full runs abort if the MT5 Common drive has less free space than this. Full-history tick CSVs are 5-20 GB per symbol.
_DoneRetentionDays_comment: Files in done\ older than this many days are purged at each run start. Only relevant when the service's InpDonePolicy is 'move' (default is 'delete'). Set -1 to never purge.

Reconcile._comment: (Optional) Verify what actually landed in MT5 and auto-backfill gaps. When absent/disabled, the pipeline runs as before except exports use BackfillWindowDays.
Reconcile._StatusDir_comment: Where QdmImporter writes per-symbol status files. Empty = <Mt5Common>\status (alongside the watch root the service scans). Must match the service's InpStatusDir.
Reconcile._ProviderLagDays_comment: Global default expected publication delay (days). Per-source ProviderLagDays overrides. Gap up to this is normal; beyond it triggers reconcile/backfill.
Reconcile._MarginDays_comment: Extra tolerance on top of lag before a day counts as a genuine gap (absorbs timezone/day-boundary fuzz).

Sources._comment: Key = QDM datasource name (dukascopy, darwinex, crypto, yahoo...). Missing symbols are auto-registered with that source. Timezone is applied to exports via the CLI timezone= parameter and shifts every timestamp - Dukascopy's raw feed is UTC-native, so EETUS (UTC+2/UTC+3 with US DST) makes bars/ticks match a typical MT5 broker's server time. IMPORTANT: changing a source's Timezone after symbols already have imported data means old (differently-shifted) and new bars will misalign - wipe the affected custom symbols and re-seed with -Full after any Timezone change. Custom symbols in MT5 are named <SYMBOL>_<source>.

Watchdog._comment: Completion is normally detected via qdmcli self-exit or log markers. These values are only the last-resort fallback.
